2607.28580.title: DualG-MRAG: Decoupling Macro-Reasoning and Micro-Matching for Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
2607.28580.paper_summary: While Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MM-RAG) has shown promising results, it still struggles with complex multi-hop reasoning tasks. Existing methods primarily focus on independent instance-level matching, which often fails to capture explicit relationships across modalities and documents. Although Graph-enhanced methods introduce structural modeling, they face a fundamental challenge in multimodal scenarios: incorporating fine-grained visual features leads to rapid graph expansion and retrieval noise, whereas coarse-grained representations cause the discarding of critical local evidence. To address this dilemma, we propose DualG-MRAG, a Dual-tier framework that introduces a decoupled architecture comprising Macro-reasoning and Micro-matching Graphs for Multimodal RAG. Specifically, to suppress retrieval noise by isolating global structural reasoning from fine-grained evidence matching, we construct a Macro Graph for global topological routing and a Micro Graph for precise local verification. Subsequently, to enable dynamic relevance propagation across heterogeneous evidence sources, we formulate retrieval as a query-driven message passing process via a GNN Retriever. Furthermore, to provide the generative model with coherent structural guidance, we introduce a dynamic programming decoding mechanism that extracts explicit reasoning paths directly from the GNN's forward pass, replacing the standard input of isolated document chunks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DualG-MRAG outperforms baselines in both evidence recall and complex QA accuracy.
2607.28580.paper_summary_zh: 雖然多模態檢索增強生成（MM-RAG）顯示出有希望的結果，但它在複雜的多跳推理任務中仍然面臨挑戰。現有的方法主要集中在獨立的實例級匹配上，這往往無法捕捉跨模態和文檔的明確關係。儘管圖增強方法引入了結構建模，但它們在多模態場景中面臨一個根本挑戰：納入細粒度的視覺特徵會導致快速的圖擴展和檢索噪聲，而粗粒度的表示則會導致關鍵的局部證據被丟棄。為了解決這一困境，我們提出了DualG-MRAG，一個雙層框架，該框架引入了一個解耦架構，包括用於多模態RAG的宏觀推理和微觀匹配圖。具體而言，為了通過將全局結構推理與細粒度證據匹配隔離來抑制檢索噪聲，我們構建了一個用於全局拓撲路由的宏觀圖和一個用於精確局部驗證的微觀圖。隨後，為了實現異質證據源之間的動態相關性傳播，我們將檢索形式化為通過GNN檢索器的查詢驅動消息傳遞過程。此外，為了為生成模型提供一致的結構指導，我們引入了一種動態編程解碼機制，該機制直接從GNN的前向傳播中提取明確的推理路徑，取代了孤立文檔塊的標準輸入。廣泛的實驗表明，DualG-MRAG在證據召回和複雜QA準確性方面均優於基線。
